name: jev-model-router
description: Corrects the model tier of every subagent spawn (agent.spawn) with a live Jev judgment (haiku / sonnet / opus), instead of relying on /delegate's static routing table. A risky task (touches production, money, or irreversible data) is always forced to opus regardless of confidence.

typesafeApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafeApiKey.description: Key for TypeSafe's own API. Falls back to the TYPESAFE_API_KEY environment variable when unset.

minUpgradeConfidence.title: Confidence to move up a tier (haiku -> sonnet -> opus)
minUpgradeConfidence.description: Being wrong here just costs a bit more; the bar is low.

minDowngradeConfidence.title: Confidence to move down a tier (opus -> sonnet -> haiku)
minDowngradeConfidence.description: Being wrong here means an under-powered subagent; the bar is high.

timeoutMs.title: Latency budget (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for Jev before leaving the spawn unchanged.

logDecisions.title: Log decisions
logDecisions.description: Write each routing decision to the session log.
